# RULES.md — the rule catalogue

**Generated by `python -m kavach.catalogue`. Do not edit by hand.**
`tests/test_catalogue.py` fails if this file falls behind the registry.

34 rules registered.

Every rule is a pure function of a view, declares its scope, and returns typed
findings. A rule that cannot run emits `UNVERIFIABLE` — never a pass.

## Class 1 — Grammar

The field is its own witness. Free, certain, needs nothing.

| Rule | Scope | What it checks |
|---|---|---|
| `C1.subdivision_number_positive` | within_version | Parcel numbering starts at 1, never 0 or negative. |
| `C1.identifier_present` | within_version | Khesra and khata numbers must not be blank. |
| `C1.identifier_charset` | within_version | Parcel and khata numbers carry digits and separators only. |
| `C1.area_positive` | within_version | A stated area must be greater than zero. |
| `C1.unit_carry` | within_version | No written component may reach the base of the unit above it. |
| `C1.area_written_matches_value` | within_version | The written area string must read back as the stored value. |
| `C1.date_ordering` | within_version | A mutation cannot predate the survey that created the record. |
| `C1.khata_number_positive` | within_version | A khata number is positive, never 0. |

## Class 2 — Conservation

Exact integer equality. The double-entry core, and the part nobody else has.

| Rule | Scope | What it checks |
|---|---|---|
| `C2.children_sum_to_parent` | within_version | Sub-plot areas sum to the parent plot's area, exactly. |
| `C2.leaves_sum_to_mouza` | within_version | Every current parcel in the mouza sums to the mouza's stated total. |
| `C2.holdings_sum_to_parcel` | within_version | Claimed areas across all khatas holding a parcel sum to that parcel. |
| `C2.holdings_sum_to_khata` | within_version | A khata's holdings sum to the total that khata states. |
| `C2.khata_totals_sum_to_mouza` | within_version | Every khata total in the mouza sums to the mouza total. |
| `C2.co_owner_shares_sum_to_one` | within_version | Co-owner shares in a khata sum to exactly one. |
| `C2.holding_shares_sum_to_one` | within_version | Undivided shares in one parcel sum to exactly one. |
| `C2.tenure_totals_reconcile` | within_version | Parcels of each tenure class sum to the subtotal the mouza states. |
| `C2.cross_unit_restatement` | within_version | An area restated in another unit system must convert back exactly. |
| `C2.share_matches_claimed_area` | within_version | Where a holding records both a share and an area, they must agree. |

## Class 3 — Completeness

What is missing, duplicated, or dangling.

| Rule | Scope | What it checks |
|---|---|---|
| `C3.parcel_identifier_unique` | within_version | No two parcels in a mouza share the same full path. |
| `C3.subdivision_sequence_complete` | within_version | Sub-division numbering runs 1..n with no holes. |
| `C3.no_orphan_holding` | within_version | Every holding points at a parcel and a khata that exist. |
| `C3.no_empty_khata` | within_version | A khata holds at least one parcel. |
| `C3.no_unheld_parcel` | within_version | Every current parcel is held by at least one khata. |
| `C3.no_duplicate_holding` | within_version | A khata is not recorded as holding the same parcel twice. |
| `C3.no_ownerless_khata` | within_version | A khata names at least one owner. |
| `C3.khata_number_unique` | within_version | No two khatas in a mouza carry the same number. |
| `C3.no_cyclic_parentage` | within_version | Parcel parentage forms a tree, not a loop. |
| `C3.records_belong_to_this_mouza` | within_version | Every parcel and khata in the set belongs to the mouza the set is about. |
| `C3.classification_is_known` | within_version | A parcel's tenure class exists in the scheme that parcel declares. |

## Deliberately not implemented

**Duplicate khata per owner** (HANDOFF_BUILD.md 4). In Bihar, partition is textual: each heir receives a separate jamabandi on the same survey number (EVIDENCE.md E1, E3). One person holding several khatas is what a correct record looks like, so this check would produce false positives at scale. `C3.no_duplicate_holding` covers the unambiguous case instead.
